newsitem.title: UK: EU seen awarding up to 100,000 T sugar at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU seen awarding up to 100,000 T sugar at tender.

text.p: The European Union (EU) is expected to award up to 100,000 tonnes of current series white sugar at its weekly tender later on Wednesday, traders said.
Another large tonnage was expected this week, with estimates ranging between 70,000 and 100,000 tonnes after the EU awarded 103,150 tonnes in its last tender on November 13.
The maximum restitution for licences this week was forecast between 47.000 and 47.002 Ecus (European Currency Units) per 100 kg of sugar, based on the Paris March white sugar contract.
The EU restitution was 47.098 Ecus last week.
